note: Attacker-controlled HTTP request bytes are copied into the static data_copy buffer
The input buffer is passed to parse_http_request for HTTP parsing
url_decode is called on the URL path, which contains literal '%' followed by bytes with the high bit set (e.g. 0x80)
When *ch is '%', the next two bytes (0x80, 0x81) are passed as char arguments to decode_hex_digit; as signed chars they have negative values
The signed char (e.g. -128 for 0x80) is cast to unsigned int, sign-extending to 0xFFFFFF80, causing an out-of-bounds read far beyond the 256-entry hex_digit_tbl array
